verdict.rationale: Clerk's Enterprise SSO docs say it supports SAML and OIDC and let users sign in with IdP credentials from Azure AD (Entra), Okta, or Google Workspace, with user data synced to Clerk. That covers the core of the story. Missing for 10: per-IdP connection setup documentation (e.g., metadata/attribute mapping, domain verification), detail on workforce-specific controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can connect enterprise identity providers over SAML and OIDC (Okta, Entra, Google Workspace) for workforce sign-in

citations.quote: Clerk supports multiple protocols for implementing Enterprise SSO, including SAML and OIDC.

Enterprise Single Sign-On (SSO) allows users to sign in seamlessly using their Identity Provider (IdP) credentials (e.g.,Azure AD, Okta, or Google Workspace) and have their user data synchronized with Clerk.
